reviews.title: It’s becoming worse
reviews.text:
We’ve been using miku for 4-5 years for our children. It just become worse and worse ever since they started to charge you monthly fee. Customer service stopped responding when asked for warranty information. 

For new parents or parents who are sleep training the babies, do yourself a favor do not purchase this product. Imagine when your baby cries and you tapped into the app and the app keeps on loading and shows you Miku disconnected/offline while you are debating whether you should go check on your baby or give it a minute - at that moment, every second feels too long.

reviews.title: This should have been a lawsuit
reviews.text: As an original Miku owner, many of us considered a class action lawsuit after the company introduced a subscription fee for core features like video recording and sleep monitoring. That’s exactly why we paid a premium price when we bought the device in the first place. They pulled the rug out from under thousands of buyers post-purchase. We now don’t get the features we originally paid for. The app is buggy and unreliable and while the contactless monitoring concept is great, the tech simply isn’t robust enough to justify the bait and switch. What a frustrating experience, and probably illegal.

reviews.title: I threw it away - useless
reviews.text: Do not buy anything from this company. The app doesn’t work - it never connects, sends false alarms through the night. Then the monitor itself completely quit working - just no lights, nothing. Company said they couldn’t help because they went bankrupt. Honestly I didn’t even know they were still selling these when they know they don’t work. I threw the whole thing away and I’m getting a different brand for the baby I’m about to have.

reviews.title: Unreliable, Not worth the cost at all
reviews.text: The app doesn’t connect to my camera about 80% of the time. Completely unreliable and unstable connection even when the camera does work. Buy a Nanit or any other camera instead.

reviews.title: Sad waste of money
reviews.text: I’m one of the few that don’t leave reviews.  So disappointed in this camera system time and time again.  We have had it for over 2 years and it constantly always disconnects, requires repairing, and always leaves us having to set up a cheap camera that works so much better in the room.  For how much you spend in monthly payments for the “SUBSCRIPTIONS” for the extras is just crazy for how bad this performs.  Do not recommend for any young parents.  Would love to hear any response from the company because we have never had any response.

reviews.title: Do not buy
reviews.text: Routine connectivity issues, and requires a monthly fee on top of a high purchase cost. You can spend 1/10 the amount on a cheaper system and have better reliability. Avoid

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: We bought this because the breathing monitor was included. They sold the company and then forced a subscription onto original users for several features including breathing monitor. We were still able to use it as a video camera and lullabies. Now the music isn’t even working. Disappointed again and again. Go with a company that doesn’t force subscriptions on you unless it’s your choice.
